description: Get the DNS records of a domain: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and NS. No account and no API key are necessary.

api_key.description: Optional. A PingDeck API key (pd_live_...). Without a key the check uses the free pool: 100 checks a day for each IP address.

domain.description: A domain name, for example example.com.

name: dns_lookup
title: Look up DNS records
